pages.text: Invisible paths stretch everywhere as Iggy the Internet wakes up. Messages are ready to travel far and fast.
Phones, tablets, and computers all join in. The internet connects many devices together.
Tiny pieces of information called data move through cables and signals like speedy notes.
Some data travels through wires under land and sea. Other data moves through the air as signals.
Wi‑Fi helps devices connect without cords. A router sends signals so data can move nearby.
Video calls, messages, and pictures travel using the internet. People can share from far away.
Learning happens online too. Stories, maps, and lessons can appear with a tap or click.
Not everything online is for kids. Asking a trusted adult helps keep internet time safe.
The internet does not think or choose. People decide what to send and share.
When devices turn off, Iggy rests. The connections will be ready again tomorrow.
